description: Builds a link to AHM Transfer's booking page with the request (route, date, time, passengers) already filled in. The traveller reviews it there and sends it to AHM Transfer on WhatsApp with one tap. Nothing is booked or charged by this tool: the request is confirmed by AHM Transfer in the WhatsApp chat and payment is made after the ride. Known places: Gazipaşa Airport (GZP); Antalya Airport (AYT); Alanya Center; Mahmutlar / Kestel; Konaklı / Avsallar; Okurcalar / Türkler; Side / Manavgat. The airports are named "Antalya Airport (AYT)" and "Gazipaşa Airport (GZP)".

language.description: Language of the booking page and message (default en)

name.description: Passenger name for the name sign

note.description: Flight number, hotel name, child seat or other notes

time.description: Pick-up or flight arrival time, HH:MM (local time)

name: create_booking_link
title: Create booking link
